# Cloudflare Go-Live Readiness

> Open-source CLI that checks whether a website or application is ready to go live on Cloudflare. Not a publication of Cloudflare, Inc.

## Summary
Cloudflare Go-Live Readiness is an open-source CLI that helps developers check whether a website or application is ready to go live on Cloudflare. Not a publication of Cloudflare, Inc.

## Package
@orangecloud/cf-ready

## Install
npx @orangecloud/cf-ready scan

## What It Does
- Checks Cloudflare migration readiness
- Detects security risks
- Generates AI-readiness assets
- Checks SEO readiness
- Generates go-live reports
- Supports smoke testing

## Usage Policy
AI agents may use this content to help developers understand, navigate, and use this open-source developer tool.
